content:
Moves the scan configuration to the specified folder.
Requires the Basic [16] user role or the WAS.SCAN_WAS.READ  custom role privilege. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string <uuid>
The UUID of the scan configuration you want to update.
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
application/json
required
string
The name of the folder to set for the scan configuration.
config_id
required
folder_name
required
